steps.heading: Final approval granted
steps.body: Judge Martínez-Olguín approved the $1.5 billion settlement on July 20, 2026 and cut class counsel’s fees to $101.6 million from the $187.5 million sought. No payments until the Effective Date.

steps.heading: Appeal window
steps.body: Objectors have 30 days from judgment to notice an appeal to the Ninth Circuit — closing on or about August 19, 2026. Most fairness-hearing objections came from non-class members, who lack standing. Class-member objectors do not.

steps.heading: Appeal freezes the payout
steps.body: One notice of appeal suspends the Effective Date. Ninth Circuit briefing, argument, and decision typically run 12–18 months — while Anthropic’s installments keep filling the fund: $450 million by September 25, 2026, the final $450 million by September 25, 2027.

steps.heading: Distributions begin
steps.body: Approval order affirmed on appeal; first payments arrive: $3,000 gross per claimed work before fees and costs, split 50/50 between author and publisher on most trade titles, paid in up to three installments.

steps.heading: Distributions delayed
steps.body: En banc rehearing or Supreme Court cert petition extends review after the appellate panel rules. Each layer of review ads months to years before any distribution.

content.title: Liquidity for locked
content.subtitle: Our principals have helped thousands of crypto holders monetize claims across nearly every major digital asset insolvency of the last decade—BlockFi, BlockFills, Celsius, Genesis, FTX, Mt. Gox, Three Arrows Capital, Vauld, Voyager, and many more.

cards.title: Exchange Customers
cards.body: We help account holders recapture the value of deposits tied up in bankruptcies and liquidation proceedings around the world. Cases drag on for years; selling your interest accelerates the payout and eliminates the need to monitor the case and navigate a confusing claims reconciliation process.

cards.title: Digital Asset Lenders
cards.body: We help lenders holding defaulted loans or locked on-chain collateral recover against failed borrowers and protocols. When underlying asset swings erode the benefit of waiting for higher recoveries, it's time to move on and put your capital to a higher and better use.

cards.title: Fund Vehicles
cards.body: We help funds with trapped capital unlock value for LPs. A claim against a collapsed exchange, lender, or counterparty weighs on fund NAV and stalls distributions. Converting claims and other interests to cash lets you return capital to LPs, who never signed up to be distressed investors.

cards.title: Estates & Trustees
cards.body: We help fiduciaries monetize crypto-related claims and interests for the benefit of all interest holders. Creditors don't want to fund lottery tickets. A clean no-recourse sale or structured funding with shared upside helps to cap costs, reduce the risk of administrative insolvency and preserve speculative value.

cards.title: Token & Equity Investors
cards.body: Holders of tokens, SAFTs, SAFEs, or equity in failed projects and companies rarely expect to get paid when things go south, but may have securities law, class action claims and third party claims or other junior rights worth pursuing and funding.
